Aine is a character from the Queen's Gate: Spiral Chaos video game and is part of the secondary antagonists in the game, like Hyumina, Aryutta, and Luna.

Appearance[]

Aine wears a big maroon bow attached to a headband in her hair, along with a white dress with pink circles of varying size, a maroon collar and black frills, and two long brown strings with drill-like attachments. There are varying sizes of openings down her abdomen, and she has white knee-high boots.

Personality[]

Despite her childish appearance, she acts like she knows it all and can't stomach cooperating with others at all; she treats especially coldly other people she doesn't like. She got used to the dialect of a planet she invaded as she was traveling various dimensions, and it became her current tone of voice. However, there's a thorn in her laid-back tone: her ability is manipulating gravity, and she crushes her enemies with the "Gravity Magnum", independently of their height or physical ability.

Abilities[]

She has a gun that can affect gravity, called the Gravity Magnum. She can focus gravity into a ball and launch it at opponents, surround herself in a gravitational field and fire gravity bullets, or, as a last resort, encase her opponents in an orb of gravity and crush them.

Trivia[]

  • She's voiced by Hisako Kanemoto, and speaks in a heavy Kyoto dialect, referring to herself as "uchi" ("yours truly").
  • Her Gravity Ball looks like the Drive Shoot, one of the special techniques used by Tsubasa Ohzora from the Captain Tsubasa manga and anime series, and also the Fire Goal attack, used by Pierre Vieira from Genesis of Aquarion.
  • Her final attack, Penetration, is also a reference to the famous "Last Shooting" scene from the final duel between Amuro Ray and Char Aznable from Mobile Suit Gundam.
  • Her drill-like attachments resemble tentacles, and it could be a reference to Hisako Kanemoto's role as Ika Musume from the manga and anime series Shinryaku! Ika Musume.
